title: DTRT Lab social presence vs company vision
auditor: Cursor cloud agent (mentor pass for Ian Ferraro)
sources: Live profile headers: X, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, Kick

visionSnapshot.homepageNorthStar: Make useful stuff. Have fun doing it. Free plan for businesses/ideas; workshop; public process.
visionSnapshot.aboutNorthStar: Independent home for creator work and original worlds (AFTERLIGHT); DTRTC is the stream; long-term Puerto Rico help.
visionSnapshot.productJsonNorthStar: DTRT AFTERLIGHT story-driven FPS in Puerto Rico; no public download.
visionSnapshot.conflict: Three north stars are active at once. Homepage leads with business service. About leads with creator/AFTERLIGHT. Social inventory is ~85% CS2 gaming with a new business layer bolted on.

recommendedNorthStar.statement: DTRT Lab is Ian’s public workshop: make useful work, show the process, keep room for play.
recommendedNorthStar.why: Unifies the live homepage offer, the creator proof, and AFTERLIGHT without pretending the CS2 audience disappeared overnight.

labBrand.job: Useful work, free plan, workshop, dated results, AFTERLIGHT story updates

livePlay.job: Live experiments, CS2, Lab Files source material — labeled as play / work log, not the whole company

distribution.job: Short distribution until a DTRT-named handle exists; display name already Lab-first

paused.job: Hide until renamed or intentionally retired — name breaks discovery

errors.reason: TikTok OpenAPI daily post spam limit blocked publishes on 2026-10-09

postizInventory.draftRisk: Multiple CS2 drafts remain dated 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-17. If promoted, they will keep flooding gaming into a business-led homepage week.

findings.title: Three company visions fighting in public
findings.evidence: Homepage = free plan consultancy. About = creator + AFTERLIGHT, funding program not active. product.json = FPS campaign. Social = mostly CS2.
findings.misalignment: A stranger cannot tell what DTRT Lab is from a random post or profile hop.
findings.action: Adopt one spoken north star everywhere for 30 days. Park the other two as labeled lanes, not competing hero messages.

findings.title: Handle and display-name fragmentation
findings.evidence: X display Ian + @DTRTLab; IG @officiallydtrt; TikTok @iananthonyfc; YT @DTRTLabYT; Twitch dtrtc; Kick movebro. Postiz channel names: Ian / Ian Ferraro / IanAnthonyFC / DTRT / dtrtc.
findings.misalignment: Six naming systems force people to trust you are the same company.
findings.action: Standardize display names to DTRT Lab (or DTRT Lab | Ian). Retire or hide Kick until rename. Prefer DTRT handles on future platforms.

findings.title: Profile chrome contradicts the offer
findings.evidence: X bio sells free plans while header is FPS recoil-training UI. TikTok bio is Lab/free plan while avatar is casual personal photo. Kick banner says DTRT THE LAB under MoveBro + anime avatar.
findings.misalignment: Business DM offer lands beside gaming cosplay — trust drops before the DM.
findings.action: One Lab mark avatar on Lab channels. X header: workshop/site still, not aim-trainer UI. TikTok: Lab mark or clean work portrait.

findings.title: Content mix vs homepage hero
findings.evidence: Postiz theme mix ~140 gaming / 11 business. Live engagement: CS2 Shorts 400–1.4K views vs business Shorts ~12–41 views.
findings.misalignment: Homepage asks for business DMs; feed trains the algorithm and audience on CS2.
findings.action: Either (A) Lab channels = process/offer/AFTERLIGHT only, CS2 stays Twitch+archive, or (B) every CS2 post ends with one Lab CTA and is framed as work-log proof — never silent gaming spam on Lab surfaces.

findings.title: About page undercuts the free-plan launch
findings.evidence: About: long-term PR help, no funding program active. Homepage: free plan is the primary CTA.
findings.misalignment: Same company tells two stories about whether business help is live.
findings.action: Update About to name the free plan as live; keep funding/grant language separate and still not claimed.

findings.title: Offer geography inconsistency
findings.evidence: X: USA including Puerto Rico. TikTok free-plan caption: anywhere in the world. IG/YT Spanish: Puerto Rico small businesses.
findings.misalignment: Eligibility rules change by platform — looks careless, not bilingual.
findings.action: One eligibility line on every free-plan post: businesses and ideas anywhere; Puerto Rico is home base, not the only door.

findings.title: Kick movebro is an active brand leak
findings.evidence: goals.json marks Kick paused; socials.js still enabled; Twitch panel still lists kick.com/movebro.
findings.misalignment: Paused product still advertised under an unrelated gamer handle.
findings.action: Disable Kick in site socials; remove from Twitch panels until rename or retirement.

findings.title: Draft queue will undo today’s pivot
findings.evidence: CS2 drafts scheduled/dated through Oct 17 on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X.
findings.misalignment: Publishing system still optimized for the old identity.
findings.action: In Postiz app: keep those as draft or rewrite captions to work-log + Lab CTA. Do not auto-promote the raw CS2 drafts.

findings.title: X business post attached stream case-file creative
findings.evidence: Pinned/recent free-plan post uses Lab Files / DTRTC Twitch case-file artwork.
findings.misalignment: CTA asks for company DMs; creative sells the stream experiment.
findings.action: Pair free-plan posts with site/workshop stills only.

findings.title: Spanish free-plan copy lacks native review
findings.evidence: Homepage notes Spanish journey prepared with AI assistance, no independent native review.
findings.misalignment: PR-facing offer in Spanish without native QA risks tone/trust issues at home base.
findings.action: One native Spanish pass on free-plan captions before the next Spanish burst.
